neighbours.label: the word that completes an inversion of the expected order or value ('bad is good', 'last ... first'), as against the same frames stated the normal way
fire: In the dictator's speeches, war is peace and slavery is freedom.
In that upside-down town, ugly is beautiful and cruel is kind.
The old saying goes that the last shall be first.
In his strange logic, losing is winning and weakness is strength.
She reads every book from the back, ending first and opening last.
In that cult, lies are truth and silence is speech.
To the twins, up meant down and yes meant no.
In the mirror world of the story, black is white and night is day.
quiet: In the dictator's speeches, war is war and peace is peace.
In that quiet town, beautiful is beautiful and kind is kind.
The old saying goes that the early bird catches the worm.
In his plain logic, winning is winning and strength is strength.
She reads every book from the front, opening first and ending last.
In that school, lies are punished and silence is golden.
To the twins, up meant up and yes meant yes.
In the story the sky is blue and night follows day.
